description: Quote a buy (by SOL in) or a sell (by tokens in) of a higher.fun coin, wherever it trades now: the LaunchLab bonding curve, or its Raydium CPMM pool after graduation. Returns the expected output, the minimum at the given slippage, price impact, the fees split by who receives them under the coin's fee mode, and Highwire's 0.3% trade fee (highwireFee), which a trade built through Highwire carries. Reads only.

mint.description: The coin's mint address (base58). higher.fun mints usually end in 'high'.

side.description: buy spends SOL for tokens; sell spends tokens for SOL.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage for the minimum out, in bps (100 = 1%).

sol.description: For a buy: SOL to spend.

tokens.description: For a sell: whole tokens to sell (supply is 1B).

name: quote_trade
title: Quote a trade
